description: Estimates an Israeli salaried employee's income-tax refund (החזר מס, טופס 135) for any of the last 6 tax years from form 106 numbers and life events, and returns the estimate per year with the bracket breakdown, a PDF worksheet of what to write in each field of form 135, the documents to attach, the filing deadline per year and the exact submission steps. Same engine as nayeret.ai/tools/tax-refund/. | בדיקת החזר מס לשכירים עם דף עזר לטופס 135. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

exclusions.description: Situations that need an annual report (form 1301) instead of 135: business (self-employed income), controlling (controlling shareholder), foreign (foreign / trust income), other (severance spread, kibbutz member, non-listed capital gain)

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

sex.description: f = woman (2.75 base points), m = man (2.25)

gross.description: Annual National Insurance payments (unemployment, maternity...), ILS

credit_points.description: Form 106: credit points the employer gave (optional)

gross.description: Form 106 field 158/172: taxable salary for the year, ILS

tax_withheld.description: Form 106 field 042: income tax withheld, ILS

entitled_points.description: Credit points you were entitled to (default: the base points for sex)

events.description: What happened that year: partial (worked part of the year), multi (more than one employer), coord (did a tax coordination), btl (paid directly by National Insurance: unemployment, maternity...), kids (children up to 18), single (sole parent), soldier (discharged in the 3 years before), degree (finished a degree), oleh (new immigrant / returning resident), donate (section 46 donations), pension (own pension / life insurance deposits), capital (stock market gains/losses, form 867)

name: prepare_refund_135
title: Prepare an Israeli tax refund (form 135)
